The clause-level detail is in each group comment.

**Stale or wrong item text, no verdict moved:**
- `api-backend.api-methods-verb-gate` A1 and N1 say restore/purge never appear in the allowed list. Since ADR-0148 / #30237 they derive from `delete`, so `['get','delete']` answers `allowed ["get","delete","restore","purge"]`. The clause's real check, that the list equals the computed closure, passed.
- `api-backend.retired-def-refusal` rev 2 quotes the `manifest.loading` tombstone. It was removed under the ADR-0087 2026-10-26 addendum (#25767 D2=A). A 17-prefix carrier now gets the generic unknown-key refusal plus the upgrade-guide sentence. The registry holds 249 entries (53 at 17, 196 at 18), not 224.
- `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix`: since #32279 the array_agg/string_agg prescription sits in `fields[].hint`, not in `message`.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract` A5: the "edit the paused node away" arm now resumes on the run's pinned body with 200. Only the deregistered-flow arm still answers 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND.
- `studio-authoring.save-door-runs-authoring-rules`: the title's "details and tabs slots" case is outdated. `slots.tabs` has been retired whole since 18.3.0.
- `studio-authoring.removed-key-save-door-refusal`: view and form refusals also carry a second issue at path '' that says only "Invalid input". The suggester proposes `aria → areas`, and a key named "" renders as empty backticks.
- `integration-system.external-schema-introspection` A2: draft fields carry `{type, label}`, not `{type}` only.
- `integration-system.connector-degraded-recovery` A3: the first retry is immediate (boot-end reconcile, about 3 s), then 10 → 20 → 40 s. A metadata reload retries at once. Neither is a hot loop.
- `cli.dev-automigrate-policy` knownGaps[1] and N3: a sqlite-wasm `autoMigrate` is now refused at build, not accepted and ignored. The `os serve` step also needs OS_AUTH_SECRET.
- `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json`: the plan lists eight lifecycle create_tables. `migrate meta` refuses `--database-url` without `--stored` (exit 1), which is not a #4873 violation.
- `cli.migrate-meta-codemod`: the stock showcase has two mode-less decision nodes, not three. negative[6] clashes with step 8's output. Step 3 should plant keys retired at 18, because a 17-retired key's conversion left with its tombstone.
- `identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal`: the "pre-verify bearer answers 401" note does not hold on a cookie session (200/400).
- `identity-auth.two-factor-disable-lifecycle`: mfa_required has three levels (off / administrators / everyone). A gated user cannot restore the setting (403 MFA_REQUIRED) until they enroll again.
- `platform-core.manifest-install-contract`: GET /api/v1/meta has no protocol field. Read the major from GET /api/v1 `version`.
- `access-security.ai-service-account-agent-ceiling` A0 and A3 name GET /auth/me/permissions with the agent's key. That door is session-only by design, so it answers any key `{authenticated:false}` and A0 can never be consulted there. The steps should also use an owner-private object, because showcase_task is public-read and hides the clamp.
- `access-security.activation-write-operator-gate` steps[4] says ledger reads are open, but a member gets 403 on sys_metadata_activation.
- `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` steps[8] has a member create a showcase_account. The object's create permission refuses that first, and the resulting generic 403 can be mistaken for the org refusal.
- `ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure` A1 names no door. The coded refusal holds on HTTP only (card-api-5).
- `ai.mcp-namespace-faces`: the action `ai.description` must be at least 40 characters. N2's only pin, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts:313`, is missing from `automated.ref`.
- `ai.mcp-tool-call-interceptor`: steps[4] should wait for health 200 before the stdio calls. knownGaps[0] can close: the inline-plugin fixture booted and all five legs held.

**Fixture gaps (blocked rows above) and recipes:**
- The walled-leg grant for `activation-write-operator-gate` A4 needs a grant placed outside HTTP.
- No door mints a raw approval token (`approvals.email-action-token-door`, five rows).
- The SLA recipe was not driven (`approvals.status-mirror-field` A2b).
- The abort-failure and 'failed'-producer seams exist only in unit tests (`attachments-storage.upload-session-abort`).
- The metadata-plane 503 arm has no door (`api-backend.action-activation-door-contract` A4b).
- No colliding-face pair is staged (`ai.mcp-namespace-faces` N2).
- `platform-core.metadata-registry-serving` A6 needs the form screenshot from a Console build.
- Stock personas need a sys_attachment permission grant before the attachment hooks can be reached.
- `identity-auth.import-invitation-and-sso-domain-answers` fixtures should name OS_SSO_ENABLED.
- `cli.meta-package-flags-and-explain`: the writable package must declare a dependency on com.example.showcase, or the view save is refused 422.
- `platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle`: a member created by the admin has mustChangePassword, so every door answers 403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED until the password changes.
- The scratch qa_b package needs `strict:false` or a dependency on qa_a to build.
- showcase_batch_reminders needs a `tasks` input when triggered.

**Environment facts for RUNNER (shared-tree traps met this round):**
- `--no-compile` boots serve whatever `dist/objectstack.json` another runner compiled last, so exporting OS_PORT is not enough. One connector boot self-pinged another runner's port; the runner caught it and discarded the boot. Items that self-ping were re-run from scratch copies compiled under their own OS_PORT.
- `qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` compiles into the shared dist.
- `os package install` writes manifests into the shared `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/`, which every later boot re-registers, and no API door undoes it. One runner's scratch pair sat there for about a minute (04:46–04:47Z). The only tree boot in that window read no package listing, and the folder is empty again.

Fixture gaps (no card): home-amount-preview-states has no editable stock carrier (see BLOCKED row: either re-point the item at an object with an editable currency field, or decide the preview should also render on a computed amount); delete-toast-undo-restore — the only Project grid (All Projects) declares its own bulk actions, which removes the built-in bulk Delete by design (ObjectGrid.tsx ~L1299; on Tasks the same path toasts "Deleted 2 Task records" with no Undo); settings-hub-roundtrip — no stock user-scope secret; activation-ledger — the ambiguous-row leg needs a second holding package; self-signup-gate ran its `invite_only` variant only (`email_domain` / `open` need a declared audience); the showcase contributor persona reads zero showcase_task rows (its `task_own_rows` compares `assignee == current_user.email`; the run had set assignee to a user id, so treat as a fixture note until someone confirms what `assignee` should store) — package-customize-restore-display's end-user render used an admin context.

Environment-fact corrections for RUNNER.md:
- a plain `cp -a examples/app-showcase` scratch copy does not boot (relative pnpm links: `Cannot find module …/@objectstack/cli/bin/run.js`); working recipe: copy into `WS/examples/app-X` and symlink `WS/packages` and `WS/node_modules` to the tree's, or replace the copy's `node_modules` with an absolute symlink;
- on a `--no-compile` boot with `OS_PORT` exported, `showcase_declarative_connector_ping` still failed `fetch failed` and the connector's metadata `baseUrl` read `127.0.0.1:3000` (RUNNER says the live dispatch follows `OS_PORT`); not scored, `connector_action` passed on two other flows;
- a reboot within 1 h on the same DB skips the first lifecycle sweep (watermark in `sys_lifecycle_state`, #29918) — lifecycle-retention-sweep steps S4/S5 are stale on that point;
- doors acting on an approval request answer 404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` (not 403) to a caller who cannot read it (`refuseUnreadableRequest`, by design) — affects request-page A1, quorum S4, decision-matrix A6/N2;
- the studio-customize-journey live spec needs more than the default 30 s on a loaded 4-CPU box with a vite dev console.

Per-item checklist-accuracy notes follow.

**access-security.share-link-landing-page**
- The item writes the route as `/s/:token`; on a CLI-served boot the page is `/_console/s/:token` (bare `/s/<token>` answers the server's 404 JSON `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). The Sign-in link's redirect is basename-relative (`/s/…`) and round-trips correctly.
- Cosmetic (not scored): the header prints the object API name ("Shared showcase_client_brief") and the hidden-fields notice prints field API names (internal_notes, deal_value), not labels; the card also lists system fields (Owning Business Unit, Queue, Id, Organization). The clause's expected string matches what renders.
- An anonymous load logs two 401s on GET /api/v1/auth/get-session in the browser console (expected for a no-session visitor).

**access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report**
- The data API refuses planting the A4 grant: POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set {permission_set:'qa_no_such_set'} → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reference_not_found, so S3's "plant a row" is a SQL write on a stopped server's file (as done).
- A4's clean-boot INFO line is invisible on a default `os dev` boot (its banner shows WARN and above only); pass `--log-level info` to read it.
- The ≤50 names cap was not driven live (2 grants); the pin covers 51.

**approvals.request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility**
- A1 member leg: the clause expects 403 FORBIDDEN; the product answers a non-reader **404 {"code":"REQUEST_NOT_FOUND","error":"<id>"}** by design (ApprovalService.refuseUnreadableRequest, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts: "Every door that ACTS on a request … answers a caller who may not READ the request exactly what it answers an id that names no request"); no row lands, so the clause's substance holds. Reproduced twice. FORBIDDEN 'actor … is not on this request' is rea…
- Related, scored on approvals.inbox-metadata-actions (ALERT filed): on this sha the request page itself renders 'Object Not Found' for every NON-admin participant (GET /meta/object/sys_approval_request → 404 for them); A4 here is the admin's view only, as the clause asks.
- A2's 404 leg is reachable on stock with a runtime grant: PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/<fresh name> {objects:{sys_approval_request:{allowRead:true}}} (200) + POST /data/sys_user_permission_set {user_id, permission_set, organization_id} (201) — no seed change needed; the item could carry this as its fixture instead of "blocked(fixture)".
- S3/A3 scratch object needs `sharingModel` declared (PUT without it → 400 INVALID_METADATA security-owd-unset) and the reader needs an object read grant; a stock member holds none on a runtime object.

**attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides**
- S0's field-owned receipt is reachable over REST: upload with scope 'user', then PATCH the invoice line's `receipt` with the fileId — the claim stamps ref_object/ref_id/ref_field.
- The acl flip in S5 works as a plain admin PATCH on /api/v1/data/sys_file (200); members get 403 PERMISSION_DENIED for the same write, on their own file or another's. The knownGap's "system write" wording could name the admin door.
- An admin attaching a MEMBER's uncommitted-to-any-record file to an admin-owned parent is refused 400 "File cannot reference this file: it is not a file you can open" — so the uploader-bypass leg needs the temp-grant-then-revoke shape used above.

**attachments-storage.inline-grid-receipt-cells**
- S8 says "re-open the created invoice": the invoice record page (a custom page layout: Invoice / Amounts sections) does not draw the line items in its first screen; the chip is read in the Edit Invoice dialog's Line Items grid.

**automation.setup-packaged-automation-board**
- The served Setup entry carries `icon: 'zap'`, a harmless extra key A0's list doesn't name. The rail/_status count is 33 on this sha (the item cites 32 from #29124); per the item, reconcile names, not counts.

**automation.package-flow-override**
- The topology edit was API-written into the Studio-created pair draft. Studio has canvas affordances (Add node / edge +), but this run did not drive a node removal through them. The label edit and every other step went through Studio.

**automation.flow-reference-package-resolution**
- The item doesn't say what status the scratch flows declare. They were authored without `status` and installed as `draft` (_status status "draft", enabled true), and the door trigger ran them, so this didn't matter.
- The environment-holder refusal's remedy, "Declare a dependency on the package that holds it (ADR-0141)", reads oddly when the holder is "the environment", which no package can depend on. The other half of the sentence (move the flow into the package) is the usable fix. This is copy nuance, not scored.

**cli.package-upgrade-plan-override-advice**
- The fixture says "customized in Studio … and published"; this run used the RUNNER pair recipe over the API (ensure-customization + PUT ?package=…custom), which writes the overlay active in one step. The hidesChange entry is the same either way.
- The view the build registers is `qa_up_ticket.default` (from a `list:` view key), worth naming in the fixture.

**identity-auth.implicit-account-linking-ownership**
- `unlink-account` accepted the sys_account ROW id as `accountId` (as S4 says); better-auth's own parameter name reads like the provider account id, so a runner reading the library docs may send the `sub` instead — the row id is what worked here.
- The fixture recipe in identity-auth.linked-accounts-social held: an inline plugin object in the scratch config's `plugins` array, calling applyConfigPatch in start(), registers the provider before better-auth builds.

**integration-system.job-package-key**
- sys_job carries no package column, so "which package holds the bare key" is read only from the INFO attribution line above (printed at info/debug level; `os dev` defaults to warn) — the item's verify could name it.
- The packages need a `body` job: install-local carries no runtime module, so a `handler` job in such a package could never run.

**platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep**
- **S4's 'boot fresh on the same file DB … and wait ≥90s' is stale since #29918** (sweep watermark): the control sweep writes `sys_lifecycle_state.last_swept_at` (row id 'lifecycle', in the PRIMARY file life.db), and a reboot inside one interval (1 h) skips the first sweep (`runFirstScheduledSweep` → `watermarkIsYoung`, packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts; the only trace is a DEBUG line). Measured: a re-boot at 05:05:03 on the same DB logged no sweep line after 3.5 min. The run…
- Also from #29918: a store a boot created from empty defers its first sweep one interval — S0's schema boot must be stopped before 60 s or it seeds a watermark that suppresses S2's control sweep (this run stopped it in time).

**platform-core.package-export-round-trip**
- On the target every package lands with source 'marketplace' (exa, exc, exd) or 'authored' (the pair) and exd is ENABLED (a fresh runtime has no disable) — so the source's disabled exd serves 404 on /meta/object/qaexd_item while the target serves it 200. Expected by the design (the export carries items, not the disable); worth one line in A5 so "serves every item the source served" is not read as a mismatch.
- Every target install logs `WARN … declares no engines.protocol range; loading under protocol 18.0.0 without a compatibility check` because the export carries no engines range for packages authored at runtime — noise a runner should not count as the A5 WARN.

**platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade**
- On route (a) 18.3.0's position door also writes package_id (com.objectstack.plugin-security), so the "position row stays null" check needs the row nulled by SQL as the flow row is; the item only says this for the flow row.
- The conflict-boot ERROR sentence says the duplicates are "two activation rows for one item the environment authored (no package)" while the item (qa183_sync_flow) is package-held — the wording reads the NULL package_id as an environment item. Cosmetic; the ObjectQLPlugin line beside it names the holder correctly.
- Every boot of this tree logs `ERROR [security] upgrade impact: 1 activation ledger row(s) … name an item no package ships … qa183_env_flow` for the planted environment row: expected for a switch row on an environment item (18.3.0's door refuses one), noted so the next runner does not chase it.

**platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal**
- Rev 2's A0/A3 and N0 are stale at ee9ad834 for `flow` (and `agent`, `email_template`, `action`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`, `api`, `function` — all namespace-scoped now); only `tool`, `connector`, `webhook` keep one holder per deployment. The variants line "a run drives flow and agent" cannot exercise the one-holder refusal at this sha.
- A2's "qa_a takes auth.password_reset over the platform's copy" is not visible on a package-less read: the platform copy still answers it. Whether the email service resolves qa_a's copy for password-reset mail was not driven.
- Types not driven: picklist, mapping, dataset, api, object-less action, function, webhook, connector, skill (tool driven as the control).

**records-forms.related-list-server-pagination**
- S0's route: clicking Northwind in the list opens a ~720px record drawer (tabbed tier: Overview/Activity/Contacts 26/… strip), not the column-tier page S1 describes; the column-tier page is the row's ↗ "Open as full page" or `/record/<id>` directly. Worth saying in S0.
- The page-1/page-2 child requests carry no `sort` param (paging over an unspecified order). Pages were disjoint on this SQLite boot; noted only as a fragility, not scored.

**records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder**
- The console's own Log out removes the `list-state:*` / `list-filters:*` keys from localStorage (LS keys after logout: none), so S5's "the cache this step tests" is gone by the time B signs in; B's cleanliness is then guaranteed by both the logout wipe and the user-keyed row. Worth a sentence in S5 so a runner does not expect to see A's keys still present beside B's.
- The sidebar's "In-Progress Tasks" (Data Slices) link opens `/showcase_task/data?filter[status]=in_progress`, a different surface from the in_progress saved view; S3's "navigate back to showcase_task in_progress" must go through Tasks + the view switcher (which lands on `/view/showcase_task.in_progress?uf__filter=…&uf__search=…&uf__sort=…`).
- The FilterBuilder/SortBuilder toolbar buttons are icon buttons (aria-label "Filter"/"Sort", testid toolbar-filter-trigger) whose accessible name gains the badge count once active.

**records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict**
- Inline dialog buttons read "Reload latest" / "Overwrite anyway" / "Cancel" (item text says Reload / Overwrite) — product labels, not a defect.
- UX nit (not scored): for a multi-field inline conflict the dialog renders YOUR EDIT / CURRENT VALUE as raw JSON (`{"annual_revenue":3333,"website":"…"}`) rather than labelled field values; single-field conflicts render the plain value.

**records-forms.record-discussion-mentions**
- fixtures.requires[2] / steps[13] say no showcase permission set grants sys_comment read and a minted member's GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment answers 403 (#26625, #27441). Measured at ee9ad834: a fresh member holds `member_default` with sys_comment allowRead true and the GET answers 200 on both the single and the group boot — the qamention_comment_reader grant is no longer needed (skipped here; reads proved directly).
- A7/S11 assert four FeedFilterMode options with changes_only = "rows of feed type field_change". Since objectstack#30074 ruling C the panel offers changes_only only for an object with field history and fills it only with sys_audit_log entries; showcase_project has no trackHistory, so the panel offers 3. Stale spec — the four-mode leg needs a record:discussion panel on a trackHistory object (none in the stock showcase).
- S6/A3: the console bell does not read GET /api/v1/notifications; it reads sys_inbox_message + sys_notification_receipt (useInboxBell.ts) and its badge counts unread TOPICS (two mentions → "1 unread topic", ×2). GET /api/v1/notifications still carries the per-row unreadCount the clause cites, and mark-read goes to POST /api/v1/notifications/read[/all].
- sys_comment.mentions is a JSON-STRING textarea: an array body answers 400 "expected a string, received an array" — steps[13]'s "mentions naming the member" should show the `"[\"id\"]"` shape.
- The walled fixture `node scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` boots from the shared tree without --no-compile/--no-watch, so a shared-tree run must hand-roll the boot (done here from the scratch copy).

**records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle**
- S2: showcase_task requires `project`; a bare padded-title POST answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (required) — the step's "valid required fields" should name it.
- Scratch hooks need no scratch package: a package-less PUT /api/v1/meta/hook/<fresh name> saves env-wide (200) on a stock boot.

**records-forms.field-type-constraints**
- Every zoo POST needs `f_master_detail` (required master-detail → showcase_project); the steps' bodies omit it — a first 201-char probe answers two field errors (max_length + required). Add it to S1–S8.

**records-forms.cascading-multilevel-and-clear**
- A1's "message key option_unavailable" is not in the HTTP body: the 400 carries code `invalid_option` and the rendered message "Province / State: option 'ca' is not available"; the key lives server-side (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:3149 messageKey: 'option_unavailable'`). Score on the code; the verify text could say "message rendered from option_unavailable".
- knownGaps[0] (no 3-level cascade fixture) unchanged: still 2-level only; no clause depends on it.

**records-forms.field-history-tracking**
- N2 probe on showcase_task: a direct backlog → in_progress PATCH answers 400 invalid_transition (state machine); step through 'todo' first.

Seen live later in the same boot: the autolaunched 'Manual Cleanup' moved under the ASSET heading once its draft gained a Create Record step on b1a_asset. By design, so not a defect — the clause's "the rest i…
